reason: Proposed short-lived risk acceptance for owner review, not a vulnerability fix. Ship independent security patches while PR #45 completes model migration validation. Critical/high model advisories remain; controls reduce exposure but do not prove these versions safe. No automatic renewal.

required_validation: Capture and compare the tracked model-regression baseline.
Meet the human-labeled evaluation and holdout minimums.
Run identical real-source benchmarks on the 3080, 4090, and 5090.
Confirm output digests and filter decisions before changing model-stack pins.
